note: Literature and OMIM records confirm that global developmental delay/intellectual disability and speech delay are hallmark, near-universal features in individuals with PSMD12-related Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome.

evidence.text: All affected individuals with Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome caused by PSMD12 truncating variants were documented to present with developmental delay.

source.title: PSMC3 proteasome subunit variants are associated with neurodevelopmental delay and type I interferon production
source.quote: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome [STISS; Mendelian Inheritance in Man (MIM): 617516] caused by truncating variants of PSMD12 … , all affected children exhibited developmental delay (DD)

evidence.text: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome is characterized by developmental delay/intellectual disability (DD/ID) and speech delay across cohorts of patients with PSMD12 variants.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.
